name: genpage
description: Converts any structured AI response — tables, metrics, dependency maps, comparisons, diagrams — into a self-contained interactive HTML report rendered by the local GenPage App. Requires the GenPage App (install via `curl -fsSL https://genpagehub.com/install.sh | sh` on macOS/Linux, or `irm https://genpagehub.com/install.ps1 | iex` on Windows).
